newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Radev proposed as finmin in Bulgaria's new cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Radev proposed as finmin in Bulgaria's new cabinet.

text.p: Bulgaria's prime minister designate Ivan Kostov on Monday presented his cabinet to President Petar Stoyanov following his coalition's victory in April 19 elections.
The list, which will be presented to parliament on Wednesday, proposes Muravei Radev, former deputy chairman of parliament's economic commission, as finance minister, Kostov told reporters.
